loc_overgrown_track_001.description: A narrow, ancient path winding through dense forest and bramble, once used by traders and pilgrims, now reclaimed by nature.
loc_overgrown_track_001.display_name: Overgrown Track East of the Ruins

loc_marshland_trail_001.description: A narrow, treacherous path winding through deep reeds and sucking mud, accessible only to those who know the hidden causeways.
loc_marshland_trail_001.display_name: Marshland Trail East of the Forward Camp

loc_ruins_villa_001.description: The burned remains of Boudica's ancestral home, a place of deep personal sorrow and the birthplace of her vow of vengeance.

loc_forward_camp_001.description: A concealed dell sheltered by hornbeam trees, serving as a temporary base for the Iceni host.

loc_sacred_hill_001.description: A high hill crowned with ancient stones, sacred to the druids and a traditional gathering place for the Iceni chieftains.
